name: 76063 · Mansfield, TX
findings: ZIP 76063 (Mansfield) has 257 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 74 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76063 (Mansfield) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
